memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah. On the east side of the Jordan they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh - Josh 20:7-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Six cities of refuge were set apart — three on the west side of the Jordan and three on the east. This careful spacing was intentional. No matter where an Israelite lived, a city of refuge was within reach. God did not place all the cities in one corner where only some could reach them in time. He spread them across the land so that refuge was accessible to everyone, wherever they were.

What thoughtful mercy this shows. God did not make safety a distant, hard-to-reach privilege for a fortunate few. He ensured that anyone who needed refuge could get to it. The roads to these cities were even to be kept clear, so that the one fleeing in desperation would not be hindered. God's provision of refuge was near, reachable, and open to all who needed it.

This too speaks of Christ, our refuge, who is never far from any of us. The gospel is not reserved for a select few who can somehow reach a distant God. Christ is near, and He calls all who are weary and burdened to come to Him (Matt 11:28). Scripture says the word of faith is near us, in our mouths and hearts, and that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved (Rom 10:8, 13). Wherever you are, whatever you have done, the refuge of Christ is within reach. You do not have to travel a great distance to find Him — He is as near as a prayer, ready to receive all who come.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe the refuge of Christ is truly within your reach, wherever you are?
- How does God's care to make refuge accessible to all encourage you?
- Who around you needs to hear that Christ is near and ready to receive them?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your refuge is never far from me. You are as near as a prayer, ready to receive all who call on You. Help me to run to You, and to point others to how near You are. Amen.
